rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep banned-words + em-dash over body lines 1-9 -> 0 hits each (view greps CLEAN, planted proof true; em-dash grep re-run: body 0, planted string 1). Harm (flinch words, silent hook rewrite) absent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Ritual / ceremony — hard ban
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -ciE ritual|ceremon|practice over body 1-9 -> 0. Harm (liturgical/coach register) absent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body grep caught live|previously|2026-|compounded|MOVED -> 0. Closest: L15 STATUS "split into three slides on his call" is dated provenance in a maintainer block, licensed by the rule (provenance header is not the journey); L15 "Owes the maintainer's read and a judging round" is stale-adjacent now that judging ran, offered as a suggestion, not owed.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L8 "It gave me anxiety, and a feeling of insufficiency." Plain first-person guide memoir, concrete and warm, no motivational wrapper (grep Remember|Hold onto|Keep in mind|Never forget -> 0); atmospheric scan: "blurry" is the essay's own literal word for uncertainty, not a sensory flourish reaching for atmosphere.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-8 are the narrator's own first-person experience, no named practitioner technique paraphrased; creator-name grep \bAntti\b|the creator|the author -> 0 in body; author-we grep \b(we|us)\b -> 0; L4 "our bets" is the narrator's own company in memoir voice, not training-as-organisation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep the student|the trainer over body -> 0. First-person narration (I) is the slide's deliberate guide voice, no delivery mechanics.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L4 "AI transformation" is ordinary business vocabulary; no maintainer-only term (claim ids, essay titles) appears in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep no penalty|fine way to|it.s OK if|not a downgrade|not on the hook -> 0. L4 "Most weeks" is a narrator frequency, not reassurance.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep vendor|aspirational|not theoretical|grounded in actual|marketing -> 0 in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L4 "AI transformation" and "bets"; both plain business words, no LLM-internal vocabulary (token, embedding, orchestration) anywhere in 9 body lines.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L8 "It gave me anxiety, and a feeling of insufficiency." "It" has candidate referents (the year, the blur, the not-seeing in L6) but the immediately preceding sentence L6 "About the future, all was blurry." is the only one a cold reader resolves; no bypass-the-agent punchline; not a trim.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep bark|order|command|whip|force|drag|boss|shout|snap|lecture|scold -> 0; no agent mentioned.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 "## About the future, all was blurry" is the slide's own first-person claim, literally the content of L6; no spatial metaphor contradicting a mechanism, no "other X".

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without the content.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L6 "I don't understand often what is happening. I don't see." two short sentences but different claims (not understanding vs not seeing), essay wording per backing; no empty negation (only "could not tell" in L4, a plain inability), no "That is the X.", no bold-label echo, no citation duplication.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing — run the truth test before reaching for §12.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L4 "Most weeks I could not tell which of our bets would turn out right." Scoped to the narrator's own year, a dated first-person report, not a claim about how the world works; no only/always/never. The backing marks it a composed join (none-owed) and the Guard asks maintainer confirmation, which is the right channel.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A claim binds to every body that states it, not just the one holding the stamp.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Ran grep -rlE "<- .*(essay-expect-to-be-wrong|essay-failing-and-succeeding)" curriculum/slides: siblings i-wanted-to-be-right, ship-the-ideas-discover-the-wrongs, the-installer-nobody-needed cite the same sources for DIFFERENT quoted claims (wanted-to-be-right, show-me-the-wrong, installer-used-just-a-bit); claim ids could-not-tell, dont-see, blurry, anxiety appear in no other body. No sibling states these four quotes.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Say it once, at its most concrete, then at most one sentence that generalises it. Style, not a gate.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L6 "I don't understand often what is happening. I don't see. About the future, all was blurry." three sentences on uncertainty, but the second and third add distinct nouns (seeing, the future) from the essay; advisory rule and fix bar (same length or shorter) leave it. No superlative so §21 does not own it.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body prose stands without the trainer — no cue-card prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep list (Take a guess|before it runs|on the screen|^Let.s go|^Go\.|Your turn|What does .* now) -> 0. Muted read: every sentence L4-8 has a verb and a subject; the only pronoun, L8 "It", resolves to the L6 blur on the page itself.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L8 "a feeling of insufficiency" is the narrator describing his own state, not a gap asserted about the student; no tier phrasing (at your scale, for a beginner, a senior) and no identity criterion (grep difference is whether|real test is -> 0).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No technical term in body L4-8; "AI transformation" and "bets" are ordinary vocabulary, audience-owned.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
rules_evaluated.evidence: em-dash grep body -> 0 (planted string 1). Sentences are short and simple; L4 is the longest and has no sub-clause aside.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep tomorrow|overnight|this morning|tonight|next morning|yesterday|last night -> 0. "a year", "Most weeks" are durations of the narrator's story, not module-timing anchors.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep sit with|let it land|take a moment|breathe|pause and|step back|meta-moment -> 0; no reflection prompt or header.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L4 "Then came a year inside an AI transformation." sets the scene the next sentence depends on (deletion test: L4 second sentence loses its "year"); every clause moves the failure story.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The curriculum does not narrate itself — subject test, then deletion test.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Subject test over L4-8: subjects are the narrator and his year, none is a module, the training or a later beat; no arc-positioning clause.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood is a design constraint, not a garnish.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Passage is the failure beat at Day 2's turn (per STATUS) and delivers not-knowing as feeling; no verification, check-the-URL or fix-the-bug step, no premature rescue in L4-8.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Self-study is invisible in the training flow.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Epistemic mood ≠ punitive mood.
